Interaction.title: Interaction
Interaction.description: A user's private reflection or journaling session

id.description: Unique identifier of the reflection session

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID owning this reflection

initialPrompt.description: Initial thought or prompt that started the session

mood.description: Optional mood associated with this reflection

favorite.description: Whether this reflection is starred as favorite

messages.description: List of multi-turn conversational messages between user and Gemini

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the session was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the session was last updated
